summary: Petition to the Central Elections Committee concerning the Aug. 30 Damon women's-prison campaign video remains unresolved on the merits.
notes: Freshness recheck found no final CEC merits ruling on this specific Damon video. The Sep.3 CEC order concerning other police/prison campaign videos is not transferred to this candidate. The original Damon post's apparent deletion remains only a media-status fact and is not treated as proof of causation or a legal violation.
